fields.Name: Overlapping Subscriptions
fields.UserQuestion: Which holders have two live subscriptions covering the same product, or a band of it, over the same dates?
fields.Description: Finance exception review (golive #279, type 5): pairs of live subscriptions for one holder whose terms overlap, for the same product or for products in the same category with the same subscription type (how bands of one product are recognised). Each overlap is billed and recognized twice unless one is cancelled. A review list: an overlap can be intended. Run at month end until the nightly exception check replaces it.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: subscription pair, ordered by creation so the later one is the subscription the overlap created. Coverage is SubscriptionTerm (excluding Canceled and Lapsed terms) over subscriptions that are not Migrated. A Canceled subscription is kept: cancelling stamps only the affected term (Canceled when cut short, Completed when ridden out), so later booked terms still bill and still count. Holder is the same HolderOrganizationID with the same BeneficiaryPersonID or none on one side (different named people at one organization are separate holders), else the same BeneficiaryPersonID when neither has an organization. LaterOverlappingTermsAmount is an upper bound: the full amount of each overlapping later term, not the overlapping part. MatchBasis is SameProduct or SameCategory (same ProductCategoryID and SubscriptionTypeID, different ProductID). Date dimension: the overlap; optional PeriodStart/PeriodEnd keep pairs whose overlap touches the window. Optional CompanyID.
